basic_profile.bio: Digital artist and indie game developer living in Austin, Texas. I enjoy creating pixel art and developing games in my spare time, often collaborating with friends online. I work as a freelance graphic designer and have a flexible schedule that allows me to be active on Reddit during late evenings and weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring the city’s vibrant music scene. I dislike spammy content and low-effort posts. My interests include gaming, digital art, and urban exploration.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital arts and computer science, having studied at the University of Texas. My passion for games led me to self-teach game development using platforms like Unity and Roblox. I often share my creations and seek feedback from online communities.
